requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience.
Experience in production Go, TypeScript, or an equivalent statically-typed programming language; and in a scripting language like Ruby (preferred) or Python.
Experience in backend software including REST-ful API design and relational databases.
Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
Experience applying AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate velocity and code quality.
Full-stack development experience, specifically with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems.
Demonstrated experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
Domain expertise in video streaming protocols (RTSP, HLS, WebRTC).
Advanced experience with AWS services (Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
